name: How long does a garage drywall installation take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a garage drywall installation take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard two-car garage drywall project usually takes 3 to 7 working days, depending on the project scope and finish level. Hanging the drywall panels typically takes 1 to 2 days. The taping, mudding, and drying cycles require another 2 to 4 days, as each coat of compound must dry completely before sanding and recoating. If you add fiberglass insulation, framing repairs, or primer and finish paint, expect additional time. Owner-operated crews manage each trade phase sequentially to ensure proper drying times between joint compound coats.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hanging and finishing drywall in an average two-car garage usually takes 3 to 7 days, allowing proper drying time between compound coats.
